name: Sheshan
overview: The Scripture introduces Sheshan as a descendant of Jerahmeel through the genealogical line recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:31, highlighting his place within the family lineage. Notably, Sheshan had no sons but had daughters, which led to a significant familial arrangement where he gave his daughter in marriage to his Egyptian servant, Jarha, who then fathered Attai (1 Chronicles 2:34-35). This account reflects the biblical record's attention to family heritage and the ways God’s providence works through diverse and sometimes unexpected circumstances in the lineage of His people.
